phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Evaluate the given integral by algebraic manipulation and identify the constant A by comparing with the given result.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Rationalise the integrand, decompose the numerator (x-7) as A·(2x-16)+B, split into two integrals, evaluate each using standard formulas, then compare coefficients with the given answer.
logical_steps: Step 1: Rationalise and simplify the integrand
Step 3: Compare coefficients to find A and B
